(6) FOMC Sep 15-16 is uncontested and lands just before the window; direction-symmetric, slightly dispersion-widening, marginal for a barrier this close. (7) ZCSH AUM ($414M vs $463M) could not be settled without retrieval; the direction is agreed and the gap does not move the number. (8) No prediction market matches on threshold, deadline, source, or structure -- all three searched Polymarket and Kalshi and found only Dec-31-2026 touch-anytime ladder rungs (thin, $3-5k on the upside legs, and internally non-monotone: $300 above $400), so no anchor, only weak corroboration of sigma ~0.075-0.09/day and a mildly negative implied drift. I land above the runs' pool because the arithmetic error I found ran in one direction.
